package.name: doa_mod
package.description: dorai direction of arrival. Subscribes to voice_mod's raw multichannel tap (the ReSpeaker's four capsules, one clock, 16 kHz), gates on a neural VAD, and publishes the POOLED SRP-PHAT bearing on /dorai/doa as the DEMO_INTERFACES JSON. The estimator (doa_core.py, vad.py, auto_calibrate.py) is vendored byte-identical from updated_beamformer/doa/ and is not to be rewritten; run tests/test_doa_core.py (21 tests) before trusting a number.
